name: Time Crack
storyline:
How far would you go to prove your innocence?

Milan has it all. Caring parents, good grades, and friends (or acquaintances, as he prefers to call them). But everything he knows collapses when he becomes the sole suspect in the brutal murder of his parents, with every piece of evidence pointing toward him.

In order to prove his innocence, Milan must unravel the lies and secrets behind the murder. But the deeper he digs, the harder it becomes to trust anyone — even himself. Is he truly innocent, or is there an ugly truth hidden beneath the cracks of reality?

Time Crack is a mystery and psychological thriller visual novel about truth, trust, and doubt. Follow Milan’s choices, investigations, and discoveries in the search for the truth — and only the truth. Will you uncover it… or be destroyed by it?
summary: A thriller and mystery visual novel about broken trust and the search for truth, when a high-school student is accused of his parents’ brutal murder. Every choice might bring you closer to the truth... or end in tragedy.
